title: 第15章 张三的反省第16章 收尾工作
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
张三话音刚落，他的腿就像弹簧一样起跳，几乎在瞬息之间就已经冲到阿斯里的面前。
然后对着惊恐万分的阿斯里，他举起了右手，准确的说是右爪，是闪着寒芒的漆黑利爪。
但是他并没有将爪子向阿斯里身上捅来，而是收起了利爪，改为握拳。
张三确实已经怒发冲冠，可他还是保持着基本的冷静。
比如：
下手可以狠，但至少别出人命。
然而这一铁拳下去，就算张三已经克制过了，这力量依然不可小觑。
“唔！！”
咚！
张三一拳打在了阿斯里的左脸上，拳头在和阿斯里脸部亲密接触时，不仅让他那张本就有些红肿的脸严重的变形，还让他下颚偏移，嘴巴歪斜，鼻血直流，此外还有两颗乳牙带着血沫从他的嘴中飞溅而出。
受了这一拳阿斯里脑袋嗡嗡作响，半张脸都失去了知觉，但是他并没有顺着这个力道被打飞出去。
原因当然不是阿斯里的下盘功多稳当，单纯是张三拽住了他的衣领。
咚！
然后在阿斯里的脑袋还在嗡嗡作响时，张三冲他的右脸挥出第二拳，第二拳也打飞了阿斯里嘴里的两颗牙齿，并且将他的耳朵都打得冒出血沫。
“啧！没劲。”
依旧死死抓住阿斯里的张三本想接着挥出第三拳继续殴打阿斯里，但见受了这两拳的阿斯里居然直接两眼翻白晕了过去不由得发出不满的咂舌声。
这承受能力实在低得可以，他就没有继续下去。
毕竟这家伙已经晕了，再打作为惩戒的痛感也很难传达给他。
况且张三也不想把这家伙打死打残，只要让他充分明白自己有几斤几两，搞懂这世界并不缺正义铁拳就行了。
而这倒也不是张三心善，若是成年人干杀人放火、打家劫舍的行当，可真就是有取死之道的歹徒，张三并不会手下留情，再加上他正在气头上，百般折磨也不为过。

但阿斯里等人现在的年纪不过六岁到七岁，也就是小学一二年纪的孩子。年纪尚小，对很多事物也不具足够的有判断力。
此时犯错，只要狠狠教训一番，还有改邪归正的可能。
现在张三教训的目的已经达到，将人打死打残都是在将事情闹大，导致节外生枝，对自己也是不利。
所以在权衡利弊之后，尽管心有不甘，但张三还是停了手。
“呀啊！”
这时柔媚突然尖叫起来，张三单手拎着已经失去知觉的阿斯里，回头一看，见那三个鼻青脸肿的男孩已经从地上爬起来，并且他们还试图复刻阿斯里挟持人质的手段，向受伤的柔媚扑来。
然而柔媚这边究竟是猫又武魂的持有者，再加上身材娇小，动作还是很灵活的，这一点从她能比张三还快的抓住剑刃就可以看出来，而且虽然她算是伤员，但也只是被阿斯里的长剑伤了手，又不是脚，所以在这几个被张三揍得还晕乎乎的男孩向自己扑来的时候，柔媚赶紧闪开了。
而柔媚这边刚一闪避，一个黑色的身影就像是旋风般从她的身旁刮过，并且他还举起了拳头，将之对准了最近的微胖男孩。
“呃啊！”
这一拳几乎没入他那圆润的脸内，虽然张三有控制好力道，尽量不打断他的鼻梁骨，但还是打得他鼻血直流，在张三收拳后，他便一头向后栽倒再起不能。
“呃？这个家伙……”
剩下那一高一矮两个男孩见张三已经解决了他们中间最厉害的两人，而且还是一拳一个，也是心生恐惧。
“我们投降！我们投降！”
明白实力差距的这两个男孩想要举手投降，可是张三却说道：
“我可是给过你们机会的，可你们不珍惜啊？”
说罢就要再次挥拳，这两个男孩立刻惶恐的跪了下来，并向张三磕头说道：
“三哥，我们也是跟着过来的，除了帮阿斯里那家伙压过那女孩，此外我们什么坏事都没做过，您大人有大量就饶过我们吧？”
“哦？”
content_en:
As soon as Zhang San finished speaking, his legs took off like springs and he rushed in front of Asri almost instantly.
Then facing the horrified Asri, he raised his right hand, or to be precise, his right claw, a pitch-black claw that shone with cold light.
But instead of stabbing Asri with his claws, he put away his claws and clenched his fist instead.
Zhang San was indeed furious, but he still remained basically calm.
For example:
You can be ruthless, but at least don't kill anyone.
However, if this iron fist continues, even if Zhang San has restrained it, its power cannot be underestimated.
"Ugh!!"
Boom!
Zhang Sanyi punched Asri on the left side of his face. When the fist made close contact with Asri's face, it not only severely deformed his already red and swollen face, but also caused his jaw to shift, his mouth to be crooked, and his nose to bleed. In addition, two baby teeth splashed out with blood foam from his mouth.
Asri's head was buzzing after receiving this punch, and half of his face lost consciousness, but he was not knocked away by the force.
The reason is of course not that Asri's lower body skills were more reliable, it was simply that Zhang San grabbed his collar.
Boom!
Then, while Asri's head was still buzzing, Zhang San punched him a second time on the right side of his face. The second punch also knocked out two teeth in Asri's mouth and made blood foaming from his ears.
"Tsk! It's boring."
Zhang San, who was still holding on to Asri, wanted to throw a third punch and continue to beat Asri, but after seeing these two punches, Asri rolled his eyes and fainted, and couldn't help but click his tongue in dissatisfaction.
This tolerance was really low, so he didn't continue.
After all, this guy was already unconscious, and it would be difficult to convey the pain of another punishment to him.
Besides, Zhang San doesn't want to beat this guy to death or cripple him. He just needs to make him fully understand how much he weighs and understand that the world does not lack the iron fist of justice.
And this is not because Zhang San is kind-hearted. If he is an adult who commits murder, arson, and robs homes, he is really a gangster with a plan to die. Zhang San will not show mercy. Plus, he is angry and tortures him in every possible way.
But Asri and others are now only six to seven years old, that is, children in the first or second grade of primary school. He is still young and does not have enough judgment on many things.
If you make a mistake at this time, as long as you are taught a lesson, there is still the possibility of correcting the mistake.
Now the purpose of Zhang San's lesson has been achieved. Beating people to death and maiming them is just to make the matter bigger, causing extraneous problems, which is also detrimental to himself.
So after weighing the pros and cons, Zhang San still stopped despite his unwillingness.
"Yeah!"
At this time, Roumei suddenly screamed. Zhang San was holding the unconscious Asri with one hand. When he looked back, he saw that the three boys with bruises and swollen faces had gotten up from the ground. They also tried to replicate Asri's method of holding hostages and rushed towards the injured Roumei.
However, Roumei is the holder of the Nekomata Spirit, and with her petite stature, her movements are still very flexible. This can be seen from the fact that she can grab the sword blade faster than Zhang San, and although she is considered a casualty, her hand was only injured by Asri's long sword, not her foot, so when these boys who were still dazed after being beaten by Zhang San rushed towards her, Roumei quickly got out of the way.
As soon as Roumei dodged, a black figure blew past her like a whirlwind, and he raised his fist and aimed it at the nearest fat boy.
"Uh-huh!"
The punch almost penetrated his round face. Although Zhang San controlled the force well and tried not to break the bridge of his nose, it still caused his nose to bleed. After Zhang San withdrew his punch, he fell backwards and could not get up again.
"Huh? This guy..."
The remaining two boys, one tall and one short, saw that Zhang San had already solved the problem among them.The two most powerful people in the world, and they punched each other, also made them fearful.
"We surrender! We surrender!"
The two boys, who understood the difference in strength, wanted to raise their hands and surrender, but Zhang San said:
"I gave you a chance, but you don't cherish it?"
After saying that, he was about to punch again. The two boys immediately knelt down in fear, kowtowed to Zhang San and said:
"Third brother, we also followed here. Apart from helping that Asri guy overwhelm the girl, we haven't done anything bad. Can you please spare us if you have a lot?"
"Oh?"
